title: Private Raku Firing Workshops
source_quote: Private Raku Firing Workshops... Fire with Passion: Explore Raku... The one day workshop lets students explore traditional raku glazes, One & Two Step Slip Resist Naked Raku, Horse Hair and Obvara firings.
evidence_sentence: The private workshops page describes hands-on raku firing where students learn traditional raku glazes, naked raku, horse hair, and obvara techniques with instruction on kiln operation.
evidence_quote: The one day workshop lets students explore traditional raku glazes, One & Two Step Slip Resist Naked Raku, Horse Hair and Obvara firings.
summary: Private raku firing workshops available by arrangement for groups or individuals. Same techniques as public workshops. Pricing scales from $400 for 1 participant to $200/pp for 7+. Contact to book a date.
how_to_join: Call 802-839-9650 or email lukeiannuzzipottery@gmail.com to discuss and book a date
